translations.web: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter?’ ”
translations.bsb: He asked them, “What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make ➔ the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that thy father did put upon us lighter?
